profile.headline: Computer Systems Analyst at Lucid Motors
profile.summary:
Specialist (18 yr) in Embedded Software for automotive industry.
Enthusiast (3 yr) in web, mobile and smart/IoT development

positions.title: Tech Specialist, Embedded SW
positions.description: In addition I take care of mantaining the Autosar Stack (EB Tresos) and our buildchain scripts. Also developed custom tools for factory ECU flash automation, DoIP and vehicle configuration strategy, and established version control methodologies and conventions (git advanced). I supported said infrastructures even outside my core Platform team, so I collaborated together with IT, Production, Quality and DevOps teams.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded automotive software platform configuration (MCAL, BSW, RTE) for single/multicore ECUs.

positions.title: Product and Service R&D (IoT)
positions.description:
While employed full time, I began participating in a Telematics project aimed at restoring the aquatic ecosystem of an O2 depleted lagoon (outside office hours and weekends). Soon another project materialized, about waste water treatment and then another for air pollution monitoring and reporting in realtime with GPS tracking.

My responsibilities include:
-Full embedded SW development for our own ECU boards
-Architecture design and implementation for: backend/DB/front developement (NodeJS, C#, MongoDB, MySQL, a little of HTML and CSS, Ajax, CGI, HTTP, Socket programming, Jquery, .Net with VS and Mono, Ubuntu Bash, Apache server, AWS EC2, etc..)
-Learning through a lot of reading.

positions.title: Senior SDET
positions.description:
This was one very surprisingly fun and interesting position.
After being on Development for years, I jumped onto Test Automation for a bit because I thought this  was a good way to learn how BT is implemented as a connection between an embedded system and a mobile app. My activities were:

Implement Bluetooth LE GATT profiles in a Nordic board (used C lang).
Implement Stetho plugin access commands for Fitbit's GATT Android stack (used Java 8)
Implement performance stress and analysis tests in mac (used python) using above components.
Configure a BT sniffer plugin in wireshark to analyze all BLE stack transactions.
Install said python frameworks and test cases in Jenkins CI pipelines (Groovy).

positions.title: Embedded SW Technical Lead
positions.description:
Worked as local SW Lead in the IoT field, with a product family that features cellular modems (GSM, CDMA) for SMS, UDP protocols, and satellite communications, GPS for geofencing and various vehicle diagnostics and reporting.
New tools: Git, ST Cubemx fot STM32 (ARM Cortex M0 and M4).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
For 4 years I grew my experience with design, code and test software for embedded electronics in vehicles (e.g. Seat heating, central computer, bootloader, EE drivers). 

Spent 3 years in a newly created position as "Process Methods and Tools" Local Contact for Mexico and Nafta. This means that I collaborated with a WW team dedicated to writing core [Sw] engineering tools that every project team is using for their product development lifecycles. These tools include: Training planning, Eng. Process Management, Change/Config management, buildchain including Static analyzers and Unit test automation. I had a lot of interactions with users that I supported with these tools, including colleagues from Mexico, USA and Europe.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Teacher
positions.description: Teaching two Subjects: Microcontrollers and Embedded Systems programming (C language, realtime concepts, RTOS evolution, SW architecture, drivers design).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for: Airbag control, occupant sensing, HVAC control module, blower motor control, in design aspects like: bootloader, control layers, driver layers, diagnostic and comm protocol layers. 
Micros: Migrating from HC08 to NEC V850, and migrating compiler, migrating RTOS. 
Tools and languajes: Assembly, C, Modeling. MMDS emulator, Lauterbach ICE and ICD. VCS, DSDS, Synergy.
